services.name: Bioluminescence Boat Tour
services.desc: Join us on a Bioluminescence Boat Tour on the waters of Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, near Orlando light up like magic! Come join us on a once-in-a-lifetime Bioluminescence Boat Tour where we GUARANTEE you see bioluminescence or you don’t pay! Our private bioluminescence boat tour takes you through the beautiful waters of Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, and Port Canaveral near Orlando-one of only a handful of places in the world where you can witness this incredible natural phenomenon. Bioluminescence is the production and emission of light by living organisms.
